posts.author: CHAC3MEN
posts.text: Molbio Diagnostics IPO coming up at PE 56, PS 6.4. 3BBb current valuation is PE 17.7, PS 7.3 and honestly better on most other ratios too. Big difference is TAM — Molbio’s is way bigger (multifold). Unless 3B BlackBio grows its TAM, don’t see much re-rating happening for them. Their move to sample-to-answer is a step in the right direction.
